text: I am glad that you have decided to spend a month purposefully working with the states of strength, decisiveness, purposefulness, passionarity... It would seem that these are natural states available to everyone. However, in society there are many both motivating and prohibitive scripts that control our behavior. By performing practices on the yoga mat and in life, reflecting, correcting your thoughts and actions, over the course of a month you can obtain important results that will manifest both on the level of the body (healing) and on the level of psychological background (satisfaction and happiness).
